_description: PWR-003 — Steady-State Rail Verification and Ripple Test — SENSOR Board
_objective: Verify all power rails reach and maintain correct steady-state DC voltage levels under nominal 5V input conditions, with no excessive ripple, drift, or dependency faults. Ripple targets are tight on the XGS45K pixel array and PLL supply rails (VAA, VAA_PIX, VAA_PIX_BST, VDD_PLL) as these feed low-noise LDOs directly powering the sensor.
_instructions: Edit values below instead of modifying the Python code. Re-run the test to pick up changes.

instrument_addresses._note: VISA address strings. Set scope to null to trigger auto-detection. Update PSU address if using a different unit for the SENSOR board fixture.

output_dir._note: Base folder for results. A timestamped sub-folder is created automatically for each run.

psu_settings._note: PSU channel and voltage for DUT input supply. Set to 5.0 V nominal per PWR-003 procedure. The test does NOT power-cycle the DUT — the PSU must already be enabled before running.

scope_settings._note: Shared oscilloscope settings applied to every rail measurement. CH1 is used for every rail in sequence (one at a time). For LDO rails the procedure recommends 2 µs/div but 1 µs/div is used here as a conservative common value that satisfies both bucks and LDOs.
scope_settings._dc_note: 10 ms/div — wide enough to average switching noise for a clean DC RMS reading
scope_settings._ripple_scale_note: 10 mV/div — tighter scale for LDO noise rails (< 5 mV spec). Increase to 0.05 for the 3V3 / 3V6 bucks if waveform clips.
scope_settings._ripple_note: AC coupling, 1 µs/div per PWR-003 procedure (bucks). LDO rails may be re-run at 2 µs/div manually if a lower switching artefact frequency is suspected.

rails.name: 5V_Input
rails._note: Input supply rail. Probe at PSU input to board.

rails.name: VDD_IO
rails._note: 1.8V LDO output supplying SENSOR IO rails. Use short ground spring on probe tip.

rails.name: VDD_PLL
rails._note: 2.8V low-noise LDO supplying XGS45K PLL. Tight 5 mV ripple spec. Use ground spring — any loop inductance degrades measurement.

rails.name: VAA
rails._note: 2.8V low-noise LDO supplying XGS45K analog supply. ±2 % accuracy range used for DC band.

rails.name: VAA_PIX
rails._note: 3.0V low-noise LDO supplying XGS45K pixel array. Critical rail — any excess noise directly affects pixel dark current.

rails.name: VAA_PIX_BST
rails._note: 3.0V low-noise LDO supplying pixel array boost rail.

rails.name: VDD
rails._note: 1.2V digital core supply. Ripple spec TBD — update ripple_max_mvpp once confirmed. ±3 % voltage band used for DC check.

rails.name: VDD_SNS
rails._note: 1.2V core supply measured on sensor side of current-sense resistor. Compare with VDD — voltage drop confirms sense trace is correct. Ripple spec TBD.
